verdict.rationale: stagewise's own agent works against the live app running in its built-in browser. The GitHub README says the agent has full access to the tab's console and debugger, and the docs say it interacts with tabs via CDP and debugs visually by taking screenshots of what users see. A community user notes that this 'look at the UI' capability comes prefabbed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the debugger access covers (e.g. breakpoints, network inspection, backend/runtime debugging), and independent hands-on corroboration of console/debugger debugging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant

citations.quote: Work with a coding agent that has full access to your tab's console and debugger
interact with browser tabs via CDP
Debug visually — The agent takes screenshots and inspects what users see
